description: The report demonstrates using a regression discontinuity design as a replication approach for experimental impact estimates of education interventions.
title: Use regression discontinuity designs to replicate or check experimental impact estimates for education interventions

description: The authors recommend that future programmes engaging CHWs to conduct RDTs direct supervision and support toward the groups and steps where errors concentrate.
title: Target post-training supervision and support to older CHWs and emphasize faint-positive interpretation conditions and explaining results to patients
